what_this_says_about_our_own_rung: Session 162's R3 net caught six files that are not grants at all (four documents or scripts about licensing, two header templates) and six that declare a licence without carrying one. At FILE level that is twelve of 156. At REPOSITORY level it is zero: every one of those files sits in a repository that also holds a licence this instrument identifies — except florinshen/FlashSplat, whose single unidentified file is a real licence. So session 162's rung has no repository-level false positive in this population, and the one repository it appears to have miscounted it counted correctly.
